context: Evaluates the initialization of a TipTap editor with a comprehensive extension set. Correct usage of useEditor, EditorContent, and the individual TipTap extension constructors is assessed, with particular weight on CodeBlockLowlight configuration (which requires creating a lowlight instance and registering languages) and TaskList/Table extension groupings.

checklist.name: useEditor + EditorContent
checklist.description: The editor is initialized with useEditor() and the resulting instance is bound to an EditorContent component via the :editor prop in the template.

checklist.name: StarterKit + text formatting
checklist.description: StarterKit, Underline, Highlight, TextStyle, and Color are all included in the extensions array with correct imports.

checklist.name: TextAlign node types
checklist.description: TextAlign.configure() is called with a types array that includes at least 'paragraph' and 'heading'.

checklist.name: Link extension config
checklist.description: Link.configure() is called with autolink: true (or equivalent) and a protocols array that includes 'http', 'https', and 'mailto'.

checklist.name: TaskList + TaskItem
checklist.description: Both TaskList and TaskItem extensions are included. TaskItem.configure() is called with nested: true to allow nested task lists.

checklist.name: Table extensions
checklist.description: Table, TableRow, TableHeader, and TableCell are all included as separate extensions in the extensions array.

checklist.name: CodeBlockLowlight setup
checklist.description: CodeBlockLowlight.configure() receives a lowlight instance created with createLowlight() (or equivalent) that has at least three programming languages registered via lowlight.register().

checklist.name: Placeholder extension
checklist.description: Placeholder.configure() is called with a non-empty placeholder string.
